No major renal dose adjustment is established because parent drug clearance is primarily hepatic. Anticholinergic, sedative, orthostatic, and cardiac conduction/QT effects are dose-related. No alcohol or substance use data are provided, so no exposure-based adjustment can be made. Routine monitoring for sedation, anticholinergic effects, orthostasis, and mood is appropriate but not beyond usual care for a TCA.
